notes.artefacts: with red wall banners added at (0,6,2) and (2,6,2) behind them, the lanterns at (0,5,1) and (2,5,1) are boxed in between two banners and barely visible from any side

visual.summary: Adds two red banners on the back of the crossbar and a plaque (wall sign) on the log base; full colour on both faces, the grandest version.
problems: Lanterns (0,5,1) and (2,5,1) are sandwiched between the white banners (0,6,0)/(2,6,0) and red banners (0,6,2)/(2,6,2): visible only as a glimpse from the sides. Widen the crossbar or relocate the lanterns (e.g. hang them from crossbar ends outside the banners).
